1. Who we are

Northwind Studio B.V. (“Northwind”, “we”) is a design and engineering studio registered in Utrecht under chamber of commerce number 81234567. These terms apply to every project we agree with you, called the “client” below, unless we have both signed something that says otherwise.

2. The work

We deliver what the signed proposal describes, in the phases it lists. A change to the scope is agreed in writing before work on it starts, with its price and its effect on the date, so that neither of us is surprised on the invoice.

3. Payment

We invoice 40% when a project starts, 40% at the midpoint review and 20% on delivery. Invoices are due within 14 days. After that we may pause the work, and statutory interest runs on the open amount until it is paid.

4. Revisions

Each phase includes two rounds of revisions, collected in one consolidated list. A third round is billed at our hourly rate of €95, and we will tell you before it starts.

5. Ownership

The finished work becomes yours when the final invoice is paid. Until then we grant you a licence to use it for the project. We keep our tools, libraries and working files, and may show the project in our portfolio unless you ask us not to.

6. Confidentiality

Both of us keep what the other shares for the project private, and use it for nothing else. This lasts for five years after the project ends and does not cover what is already public or what the law requires us to disclose.

7. Liability

Our liability for any claim about a project is limited to the amount you paid us for it in the twelve months before the claim. We are not liable for indirect loss such as lost revenue or lost data.

8. Ending an agreement

Either of us may end a project with 30 days’ written notice. You pay for the work done up to the end date, and we hand over everything finished so far.

9. Governing law

Dutch law applies. A dispute we cannot settle between us goes to the court in Utrecht.

We take photos at the Halcyon workshop on 14 March. If you agree, we may use the ones you appear in on our website and in the newsletter for two years. You can change your mind at any time by writing to hello@northwind.example.

One email a month about what we are building. We never share your address, and every email has an unsubscribe link.
